content: 1) Encourage individuals to adopt eating patterns that prioritize nutrient-dense foods in appropriate portion sizes. 2) Tailor nutritional recommendations to meet the unique needs of each individual, taking into account their cultural and personal food preferences, level of health literacy, and access to nutritious food options. 3) Equip individuals with the necessary knowledge and skills to make informed dietary choices, thereby fostering their confidence and ability to effectively manage their nutritional needs. 4) Emphasize the use of practical tools and strategies to establish sustainable and healthy eating habits, rather than focusing solely on specific macronutrients or individual food items.
